clips.title: The story
paras: Daryl the Youngling is a human hunter residing at Farstrider Lodge in the southeastern hills of Loch Modan. Eager to prove his marksmanship among veteran dwarven trackers, he challenges traveling adventurers to hone their wilderness skills and test their mettle against the local beasts.

Farstrider Lodge is primarily a haven for dwarven mountaineers, trackers, and seasoned outdoorsmen who watch over the wilderness of Loch Modan. Daryl stands out as a young human striving to earn his place alongside these veteran stalkers. Rather than relying on mere bravado, he actively seeks to measure his hunting instincts against other travelers, issuing challenges to hunt down the tough wild boars and beasts roaming the crags and lakeshore.
